{"metadata":{"description":"Model-driven context-window rollover bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: fresh working context, durable notes, verbatim recent tail, no summarization","id":"gh:1359026698","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-context-rollover","slug":"athif23/dsh-context-rollover","topics":["ai-agent","compaction","context-management","context-window","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Model-driven context-window rollover bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: fresh working context, durable"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" notes, verbatim recent tail, no summarization"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-context-rollover"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness bundle for
**model-driven context self-management**: the model can deliberately e"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"nd one
working context window and continue in a fresh one while preserving durable
state — with **no"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ntext window and continue in a fresh one while preserving durable
state — with **no summarization**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Inspired by the context-management architecture in `openai/codex` (the
`new_context` tool, token-bud"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"get compaction without a summarizer, history/notes
separation) and `pi-posthorse`. Codex is the arch"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"itectural reference; DSH is the
implementation authority — everything runs through DSH's own surface"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"-replace
protocol and compaction transaction."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Web profile: rollover only runs in the `standard-rollover` preset.**
>
> Installing this bundle "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"is not enough on its own. The Web profile composes
> compaction from the session's **agent preset**,"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" and the default preset
> (`standard`) stays exactly as shipped: it keeps the built-in summarizer an"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"d
> gets **no rollover tools and no rollover guidance** — no `new_context`, no
> `get_context_remain"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ing`, no `notes`, no `history`. A `standard` session
> cannot roll over at all.
>
> To use it, open "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"a **new** session and select **"Standard + rollover
> (experimental)"** in the preset picker *before"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" sending the first message* —
> a session's preset is frozen once its first turn runs.
>
> Headless "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"and other rosterless profiles are the exception: they have no preset
> roster, so the host engine se"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"rves every session and there is nothing to pick."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin provides the active `ctx.compaction` engine (it disables
`dsh-compaction-basic` in its bu"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ndle patch). On the Web profile the engine
must additionally live in the session's agent preset — se"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e
Web profiles below. A rollover is a real DSH
compaction: `compaction/start` → `compaction/summary`"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" → one replacement
`user/message` with full source provenance → `compaction/end` — but the
"summary""},{"id":"p8s5","text":" is a **deterministic checkpoint** (durable notes plus an optional
handoff), never an LLM call. Raw "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"session events stay persisted; a
token-budgeted recent tail stays verbatim on the surface; `deriveMe"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ssages()`
rebuilds automatically."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Responsibilities stay split (the Codex lesson):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Concern | Owner |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Request a boundary | `new_context` tool (records a pending request only) |
| Cross the boundary | "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`agent/pre-step` (before the next model request) and `agent/turn-stopping` |
| Track windows | rollo"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ver count + summary seqs read from the durable log |
| Measure pressure | `ctx.tokenMeter` + the rou"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ted model's context window |
| Replace the surface | `commitRollover` inside DSH's compaction transa"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ction |
| Preserve selected state | `notes` tool (markdown files per session) |
| Recover old detail"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"s | `history` tool (search/read over shadowed surface events) |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Model-facing tools"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **`new_context({ handoff? })`** — request a context boundary at the next safe
point. The handoff ("},{"id":"p13s2","text":"bounded) becomes part of the new window's checkpoint. The
boundary is crossed at a safe lifecycle po"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"int, never mid-tool-batch.
- **`get_context_remaining()`** — honest headroom: tokens left before the"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" hard
window and before the automatic rollover, or "not measured yet".
- **`notes`** — `list | read "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"| write | append | search` over per-session
markdown files under `<dsh home>/notes/<session id>/`. N"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"othing is written
automatically; the model decides what survives.
- **`history`** — `search | read` "},{"id":"p13s7","text":"over conversation that left the active
surface. Targeted recovery, not wholesale reconstruction."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Rollover paths"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **Model-driven** (preferred): the model saves notes, calls `new_context`
with a short handoff at "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"a phase boundary (research → implementation, etc.).
2. **Pressure** (safety net): above `thresholdRa"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"tio` of the window the engine
rolls over automatically with durable notes and the recent verbatim ta"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"il.
Below that, a **one-per-window** checkpoint reminder suggests saving notes
and rolling over.
3. "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"**Overflow**: a provider-confirmed `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` forces a
rollover with the same notes +"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" tail checkpoint and retries the request.
4. **Manual**: `/compact` keeps working — it performs the "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"same standalone
notes + tail rollover on an idle agent."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Only the model-driven path carries a **handoff**. The engine never writes one
for pressure, overflow"},{"id":"p16s2","text":", or manual rollovers: producing a handoff itself would
mean either an LLM summarization call or cop"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ying older user messages into the
fresh window, and the second option revives stale requests. Those "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"paths
preserve intent through notes and the recent verbatim tail instead."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## What this plugin touches"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Registers four model-facing tools** (`new_context`, `get_context_remaining`, `notes`, `history`)"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"
and one system-prompt section — on headless profiles in every session; on
the Web profile only insi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"de `standard-rollover` sessions (other presets stay
exactly as shipped).
- **Writes files** in exact"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ly one place: markdown notes under `<dsh home>/notes/<sessionId>/`.
Nothing else on disk is written;"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" no network calls, no telemetry.
- **Replaces the active compaction backend** (`compaction-basic` is"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" disabled by the bundle patch).
Session logs stay fully compatible in both directions.
- **No creden"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"tials, no cloud services, no data leaves the machine.**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Host version compatibility"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The plugin typechecks against **both** host lines: the development checkout and
its installed profil"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"es (`0.1.6-alpha.1`, via generated tsconfig paths) and the
newest packages published to public npm ("},{"id":"p20s3","text":"`0.0.1-rc.1`, the
`pnpm typecheck:compat` probe against `compat/node_modules`). Runtime
differences "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"are bridged in `src/compat.ts`:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- the session log as `snapshotEvents()` (newer line) or `events` (published);
- `eventAt(seq)` versu"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"s indexing that array;
- per-node pricing as `heuristicTokens` (newer line) or `tokens`;
- the repla"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"cement operation as `{ startSeq, endSeq }` (newer line) or
`{ start, end }`, probed once per process"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" because each line rejects the
other's field names."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Note the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages are a *partial* mirror: some
of their peers referen"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ce packages that were never published publicly, so a
standalone npm-only host graph cannot be assemb"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"led. That is expected — the
plugin's peers resolve from the running dsh host's installation closure,"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" and
installing the plugin itself into a profile fetches only this package."}],"truncated":true}
